title: Hypothesis testing: p-values, significance, and interpretation
learning_objective: A p-value measures compatibility with the null model; it is not the probability that the null is true.; Students explain their reasoning using evidence from the worked example.; Students identify and repair at least one common misconception during guided practice.
common_misconceptions: p = 0.03 means a 3% chance the null hypothesis is true.
Statistical significance automatically means practical importance.
Failing to reject the null proves there is no effect.
